title: Yummy Algerian Dates Paella
description: A fragrant, herb-infused paella with chewy dates and a swirl of sugar‑free ice cream, served from a traditional paella pan.

ingredients.name: saffron threads
ingredients.notes: soaked in a tablespoon of warm almond milk

instructions: Heat the infused olive oil in a paella pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the rice and stir quickly to coat each grain with oil, then pour in the saffron‑infused almond milk.
Add the dates, salt, pepper, and lemon zest, stirring to combine.
Cover the pan, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid, and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes until the rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Swirl in the sugar‑free ice cream until it melts into a creamy sauce that coats the paella.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot straight from the pan.
